name: i3 Verticals, Inc.
summary: i3 Verticals, Inc. provides enterprise software and services solutions to public sector entities in the United States and Canada. The company offers digital solutions for dynamic processes to plan, coordinate, evaluate, record, and provide up to date information within court systems; E-Filing and revenue cycle management solutions for courts; solutions for computer aided dispatch, records management, evidence management, jail management, mobile solutions, and livescan; and software solutions for vehicle title and registration, driver's license and permit management, and motor carrier compliance for departments of transportation.
